It calls `WfPredicates::nominal_obligations`, `WfPredicates::cause`, `WfPredicates::tcx`, `WfPredicates::require_sized`, `WfPredicates::compute_projection`, `WfPredicates::compute_inherent_projection`, and `WfPredicates::from_object_ty`.

Builds instantiated predicate obligations from the declared predicates of a nominal item and all of its predicate-bearing parents, tagging each with an appropriate item/binding cause and filtering out obligations with escaping bound vars. It calls `WfPredicates::tcx` and `WfPredicates::cause` while constructing the obligations.

Generates outlives obligations implied by a trait object's existential predicates and explicit object lifetime bound, requiring the explicit bound to outlive each implicit bound extracted from the object. It calls `object_region_bounds`, `WfPredicates::tcx`, and `WfPredicates::cause`.

Computes the region bounds required by a trait object's existential predicates by substituting a fresh placeholder self type, ignoring projection predicates, and delegating the final extraction to `required_region_bounds`. It calls `required_region_bounds`.

Computes the well-formedness obligations induced by a trait reference by first gathering its nominal obligations via `nominal_obligations`, then packaging each resulting predicate into derived obligations with adjusted causes, including `extend_cause_with_original_assoc_item_obligation` for better associated-item diagnostics. When elaboration is enabled, it additionally calls `with_depth` and `elaborate_obligations` to expand supertrait-style requirements and extends the accumulated obligation set with those results; it also recursively calls `compute_trait_ref` for nested trait-reference arguments found in the trait substitutions.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/check/regionck: Trait method declaration for adding implied outlives bounds derived from function-signature or well-formedness types into an outlives environment. It calls `add_implied_bounds` via the concrete implementor.

Iterates over the provided types, resolves inference variables in each type, computes implied outlives bounds for the body, and records those bounds in the environment. It calls `resolve_vars_if_possible`, `implied_outlives_bounds`, and `add_outlives_bounds`.

Runs late region checking for a standalone expression body by constructing a RegionCtxt with `RegionCtxt::new`, saving implied bounds for the body owner, then—if type checking has not already errored—calling `visit_body` and `visit_region_obligations`. It finishes by skipping classic region resolution because NLL handles it.

Performs item/WF region checking by creating a RegionCtxt with `RegionCtxt::new`, extending the outlives environment via `add_implied_bounds`, saving those bounds, then calling `visit_region_obligations` and `resolve_regions_and_report_errors`.

Runs region checking for a function body by creating a RegionCtxt with `RegionCtxt::new`, adding and saving implied bounds from the function WF/signature types via `add_implied_bounds`, and, if no prior typeck errors exist, calling `visit_fn_body`. It ends by skipping classic region resolution in favor of NLL.
Returns the wrapped `FnCtxt`, letting `RegionCtxt` transparently dereference to the underlying function type-checking context.
Constructs a new RegionCtxt for a body/subject pair, initializing a fresh `OutlivesEnvironment` and storing the function context, current body id, body owner, and subject def-id.
Resolves inference variables in a type while leaving region variables available for later lifetime constraint collection by calling `resolve_vars_if_possible`.
Fetches the type of a HIR node with `node_ty` and then calls `resolve_type` to normalize unresolved inference variables.

Sets up region checking for a function or closure body by updating the current body state, collecting input/output types to derive implied bounds, then calling `add_implied_bounds`, `save_implied_bounds`, `link_fn_params`, `visit_body`, and `visit_region_obligations`.

Region-checks an inline const body in an isolated outlives-environment snapshot: it saves state, updates the current body, saves implied bounds, then calls `visit_body` and `visit_region_obligations`, and finally restores the previous snapshot and body state.
Processes any pending trait/type obligations that may generate additional region constraints by calling `select_all_obligations_or_error`.

Completes classic region solving for item checking by calling `process_registered_region_obligations` with the outlives environment’s region-bound pairs, then `fcx.resolve_regions_and_report_errors` for the current subject.
Applies drop-liveness constraints to each pattern binding by iterating bindings, calling `resolve_node_type` for each bound variable type, and then `dropck::check_drop_obligations`.
Handles nested closure bodies during HIR traversal by snapshotting the outlives environment, calling `visit_fn_body` on the closure body, and then restoring the previous snapshot and body state.
Visits a match arm by first calling `constrain_bindings_in_pat` on the arm pattern, then delegating the rest of traversal to `intravisit::walk_arm`.
Visits a local binding by calling `constrain_bindings_in_pat` for drop constraints, `link_local` to relate initializer borrows to the pattern, and then `intravisit::walk_local`.

Visits expressions while building region constraints: it first calls `constrain_adjustments`, then `check_safety_of_rvalue_destructor_if_necessary` on the resulting place when available, and dispatches by expression kind to call `link_addr_of` for `&` borrows, `link_match` for matches, `visit_inline_const` for const blocks, or otherwise continue traversal with `intravisit::walk_expr`.
Creates a `MemCategorizationContext` from the current inference context, param env, body owner, and typeck results, then invokes the supplied callback with it.

Computes region constraints introduced by autoderef/autoref adjustments. It calls `with_mc` to categorize the unadjusted expression, `check_safety_of_rvalue_destructor_if_necessary` before applying adjustments, and then for each adjustment may call `link_region` for overloaded deref borrows or `link_autoref` for autorefs, finishing by re-categorizing the adjusted expression with `with_mc`.
For a pure rvalue place, enforces any drop-related outlives requirements by calling `resolve_type` on the place type and then `dropck::check_drop_obligations`.
Registers a region obligation requiring a type to outlive a region by calling `register_region_obligation` on the inference context.
Builds region constraints for an explicit `&` borrow by categorizing the base expression with `with_mc` and then calling `link_region_from_node_type` using the borrow expression’s reference type.

Relates a local initializer to its binding pattern: if an initializer exists, it categorizes it with `with_mc` and then calls `link_pattern` to propagate borrow-region constraints into the pattern bindings.
Relates a match discriminant to each arm pattern by categorizing the discriminant with `with_mc` and then calling `link_pattern` for every arm.
Creates rvalue categorizations for function parameters and links them to their patterns by calling `with_mc` for each parameter and then `link_pattern`.

Walks a pattern against a categorized source place by calling `with_mc`/`cat_pattern`; for each by-reference binding it detects, it calls `link_region_from_node_type` to enforce the binding’s borrow lifetime.
Applies region constraints for an implicit autoref adjustment: for `AutoBorrow::Ref` it calls `link_region`, while raw-pointer autoref adjustments add no region constraints.
Extracts the reference region from a node’s resolved type by calling `resolve_node_type`, and if the type is `&T`, calls `link_region` to relate that borrow region to the borrowed place.

Core borrow-linking routine: it first calls `type_must_outlive` to require the borrowed place type to outlive the borrow region, then walks dereferenced pointer layers and may call `link_reborrowed_region` for nested references or `link_upvar_region` for upvar captures, stopping early on raw pointers or when reborrow handling determines no further recursion is needed.

Adds the fundamental reborrow constraint that the new borrow region is a subregion of the referenced region by calling `sub_regions(infer::Reborrow(...), ...)`, and returns whether reborrow propagation should stop based on mutability/borrow semantics.

Constrains borrows of captured upvars so they cannot outlive the closure environment borrow. It inspects closure capture info and, for by-reference captures, calls `sub_regions(infer::ReborrowUpvar(...), ...)`; for by-value closure captures it additionally analyzes the closure type and synthesized free region information to derive the required relation.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_infer/src/infer/outlives/: Constructs a new `OutlivesEnvironment` from the given `ParamEnv` by initializing empty region-bound storage and then populating it with the explicit outlives bounds from the parameter environment. It explicitly calls `explicit_outlives_bounds` to obtain declared bounds and `add_outlives_bounds` to record them.
Returns a shared reference to the environment’s `FreeRegionMap`. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.
Returns a shared reference to the map that stores accumulated region-bound pairs per `HirId`. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.

Captures a snapshot point for child type checking by returning the current length of the accumulated region-bound list, so later additions can be rolled back. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.
Restores the accumulated region-bound list to a previously saved snapshot length after child type checking by truncating later additions. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.

Saves the current accumulated implied bounds under the given `body_id` by cloning the current region-bound pairs into the per-body map and asserting that no prior entry existed. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.

Consumes additional `OutlivesBound` facts and integrates them into the environment: parameter and projection bounds are appended to the accumulated region-bound pairs, while region-to-region bounds are forwarded into inference/free-region relations when the regions are of supported kinds. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/outlives/outli: Trait method contract for computing implied outlives bounds for a type in a given parameter environment and body context; its implementation is provided by the `InferCtxtExt` impl and calls `impl<'cx, 'tcx> InferCtxtExt<'tcx> for InferCtxt<'cx, 'tcx>::implied_outlives_bounds`.

Computes implied outlives bounds by running the implied-outlives type op in the current inference context, returning an empty vector after `delay_span_bug` if solving fails. When constraints are produced, it creates obligations with `query_outlives_constraint_to_obligation`, registers them with `register_predicate_obligation`, resolves them via `select_all_or_error`, checks `is_empty`, and reports unsolved work with `delay_span_bug`; it also uses `misc`, `clone`, and `new` while building and processing the fulfillment context, and `and` plus `fully_perform` to invoke the underlying type operation.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/type_check/f: Constructs a `UniversalRegionRelationsBuilder` from the inference context, parameter environment, universal regions, and constraint buffer, initializes its relation stores to defaults, clones the shared `UniversalRegions`, and then calls `UniversalRegionRelationsBuilder::create` to build the final `CreateResult`.

Computes the postdominating upper bound of two universal regions by asserting both are universal with `is_universal_region`, calling `inverse_outlives.postdom_upper_bound`, and falling back with `unwrap_or` to `'static` when no bound is found.
Finds all non-local upper bounds for a universal region by calling `non_local_bounds` on `inverse_outlives`, then asserting the resulting set is non-empty before returning it.

Finds a single non-local lower bound by calling `non_local_bounds` on `outlives`, reducing the candidates with `outlives.mutual_immediate_postdominator`, and filtering the result with `is_local_free_region` so only non-local regions are returned.

Performs a graph walk from a universal region to collect reachable non-local bounds: it first checks `is_universal_region`, then repeatedly pops work items, uses `is_local_free_region` to decide whether to record a region or continue, and expands local regions by calling `relation.parents`.
Answers whether one universal region outlives another by calling `self.outlives.contains(fr1, fr2)`.
Returns all regions outlived by a given region by calling `self.outlives.reachable_from(fr1)`.
Exposes the directly known outlives edges by calling `self.outlives.base_edges()` and returning its iterator.

Builds the complete free-region relation set and associated borrowck assumptions. It calls `add_outlives_bounds` to seed explicit predicates, repeatedly calls `relate_universal_regions` to add reflexive, `'static`, and `'fn_body` relations for each universal region, calls `add_implied_bounds` for each unnormalized and normalized input/output type, normalizes each type with `param_env.and(...Normalize::new(...)).fully_perform`, records generated constraints, then calls `push_region_constraints` for each collected constraint set and finally `freeze` to package the finished `UniversalRegionRelations` into the returned `CreateResult`.

Computes implied outlives bounds for a type by invoking `param_env.and(ImpliedOutlivesBounds { ty }).fully_perform`, discarding errors with `map_err(...).ok()`, then calling `add_outlives_bounds` on the returned bounds and yielding any accompanying query region constraints.

Incorporates outlives assumptions into the builder by iterating each `OutlivesBound`: for `RegionSubRegion`, it calls `to_region_vid` on both regions and then `relate_universal_regions` to record the relation; for `RegionSubParam` and `RegionSubAlias`, it inserts the corresponding `ty::OutlivesPredicate` into `region_bound_pairs`.

Adds a universal-region outlives edge `fr_a: fr_b` to both relation graphs, recording the forward edge in `outlives` and the reverse edge in `inverse_outlives`. It calls `add` on both transitive relations.

Computes a single representative non-local upper bound for `fr` by first calling `non_local_upper_bounds`, then collapsing the candidates with `inverse_outlives.mutual_immediate_postdominator`. It filters that result using `universal_regions.is_local_free_region`, returning the postdominator when it is non-local and otherwise falling back to the external region.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/type_check/c: Constructs and returns a `ConstraintConversion` with the provided inference, region, environment, location, and output-constraint state, initializing `tcx` from `infcx` and `from_closure` to `false`. It does not call other methods in this file.

Imports all query-produced region constraints into the borrowck constraint set: it temporarily takes member constraints, re-adds each member constraint with region mapping via `to_region_vid`, then lowers every outlives predicate by calling `convert`.

Lowers a single outlives predicate into concrete borrowck constraints. For region-vs-region predicates it calls `to_region_vid` on both regions and then `add_outlives`; for type-vs-region predicates it delegates decomposition to `TypeOutlives::type_must_outlive` using this conversion as the delegate.
Builds a borrowck `TypeTest` from a generic kind, lower-bound region, and verification bound by converting the region with `to_region_vid`.

Maps a region into a local `RegionVid`, creating or reusing a placeholder-region variable for placeholder regions and otherwise using the universal-region mapping. It does not call other methods in this file.

Appends a concrete `OutlivesConstraint` to the output set, choosing either the passed category or the conversion's current category when it is more specific. It does not call other methods in this file.
Appends a generated `TypeTest` to the output constraint set. It does not call other methods in this file.
Implements the `TypeOutlivesDelegate` hook for subregion requirements by converting both regions with `to_region_vid` and recording the resulting relation with `add_outlives`.

Implements the `TypeOutlivesDelegate` hook for verification requirements by first normalizing placeholders with `replace_placeholders_with_nll`, then building a `TypeTest` with `verify_to_type_test`, and finally recording it with `add_type_test`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/type_check/m: Top-level MIR borrowck type-checking pipeline. It initializes region-constraint storage, calls `free_region_relations::create` to compute universal-region relations and normalized signature types, constructs a `TypeChecker` with `TypeChecker::new`, then invokes `TypeChecker::check_user_type_annotations`, `TypeVerifier::new`, `TypeVerifier::visit_body`, `TypeChecker::typeck_mir`, `TypeChecker::equate_inputs_and_outputs`, `TypeChecker::check_signature_annotation`, `liveness::generate`, and `translate_outlives_facts` before finalizing opaque-type/member constraints and returning the accumulated `MirTypeckResults`.

Creates a `TypeChecker` with `TypeChecker::new`, runs a defensive `TypeVerifier` over the MIR by constructing it with `TypeVerifier::new` and calling `visit_body`, then, if verification reported no errors, performs the main MIR type-checking pass via `typeck_mir`; finally it invokes the supplied callback `extra` with the checker.

Exports collected outlives constraints into Polonius subset facts when fact generation is enabled. It calls `Locations::from_location` on each constraint to decide whether to emit a single location fact or facts for all points, then extends `subset_base` accordingly.
Reports broken MIR as a delayed compiler bug to avoid premature hard failures for known predicate-checking situations; it forwards the message to `span_delayed_bug`.
Tracks the most recent non-dummy span seen during MIR traversal so later verifier diagnostics can point at a useful source location.
Verifies each visited place by calling `TypeVerifier::sanitize_place`.

Checks constants for structural and typing validity. It calls `super_constant` to recurse, `TypeVerifier::sanitize_type` to validate the constant type, records liveness for free regions, uses `TypeChecker::relate_type_and_user_type` when a user type annotation is present, and for unevaluated/promoted constants may call `TypeChecker::eq_types`, `TypeVerifier::sanitize_promoted`, `TypeChecker::ascribe_user_type`, `TypeChecker::normalize`, `TypeChecker::check_static_ptr`, `TypeChecker::normalize_and_prove_instantiated_predicates`, and `TypeChecker::prove_predicates` to validate promoted bodies, statics, and callable/predicate requirements.
Recurses through an rvalue with `super_rvalue`, computes its MIR type, and calls `TypeVerifier::sanitize_type` to ensure the inferred rvalue type is valid.

Checks each local declaration. It calls `super_local_decl`, validates the declared type with `TypeVerifier::sanitize_type`, and for user type annotations calls `TypeChecker::relate_type_and_user_type` against the adjusted binding type.
Verifies the body-level return type by calling `TypeVerifier::sanitize_type`, then traverses the rest of the MIR with `super_body`.
Constructs a `TypeVerifier` from an existing `TypeChecker`, storing the promoted bodies and initializing the last span from the current body span.
Returns the MIR body currently being verified.
Returns the `TyCtxt` from the underlying type-checking context.
Rejects obviously invalid MIR types by checking for escaping bound vars or error types; otherwise returns the type unchanged.

Validates a place and computes its resulting `PlaceTy`. It starts from the base local type, calls `TypeVerifier::body` and `TypeVerifier::sanitize_projection` for each projection element, uses `TypeVerifier::tcx` when manufacturing error types, and for copy uses calls `TypeChecker::prove_trait_ref` to require that the final type implements `Copy`.

Type-checks a promoted body in isolation and remaps its generated constraints back onto the parent body at a single use location. It swaps in temporary constraint storage, calls `TypeVerifier::visit_body` and `TypeChecker::typeck_mir` on the promoted MIR, then merges outlives and liveness information into the parent context.

Validates one projection step and computes the projected `PlaceTy`. It uses `TypeVerifier::tcx` and `TypeVerifier::body` for type queries, calls `TypeVerifier::sanitize_type` for field results, `TypeVerifier::field_ty` to resolve field access, `TypeVerifier::get_ambient_variance` to determine variance from the use context, and `TypeChecker::normalize` plus `TypeChecker::relate_types` to enforce subtyping/equality constraints introduced by field and opaque-cast projections.
Creates and returns a generic miscellaneous error type using `TypeVerifier::tcx`.

Resolves the type of a field access for structs, enums, closures, coroutine closures, tuples, and coroutine state. It calls `TypeVerifier::tcx` for layout/type queries and `TypeChecker::normalize` before returning field types that depend on instantiated arguments.

Interns a placeholder region into the MIR type-checking constraint set. It reuses an existing mapped region when present; otherwise it creates a fresh NLL region variable and stores it for later reuse.
Returns the concrete source `Location` for `Locations::Single`, or `None` for `Locations::All`.
Returns the representative span for a location set, using the stored span for `All` or the body source info for `Single`.

Constructs the main MIR `TypeChecker` with the borrowck/typeck inputs and empty error tracking. If the next trait solver is enabled for a non-child body, it also calls `TypeChecker::register_predefined_opaques_for_next_solver`.
Returns the MIR body being checked.
Returns whether unsized locals or unsized function parameters are enabled in the current feature set.

Processes canonical user type annotations attached to the MIR body. It calls `TypeChecker::instantiate_canonical_with_fresh_inference_vars`, then dispatches to either `TypeChecker::check_inline_const` for inline-const `TypeOf` annotations or `TypeChecker::ascribe_user_type` for ordinary annotations.

Converts solver-produced region constraints into MIR borrowck constraints by constructing a `constraint_conversion::ConstraintConversion` and calling its `convert_all` method; it also uses `Locations::span` to supply an error span.
Enforces that `sub` is a subtype of `sup` by calling `TypeChecker::relate_types` with contravariant comparison on the expected/supertype side.
Enforces type equality by calling `TypeChecker::relate_types` with invariant variance.

Walks a user type projection from its annotated base type, normalizes each projected field, and then relates the final projected type to `a` with variance-adjusted subtyping. This method explicitly calls `normalize` while resolving projected fields and then calls `relate_types` on the final type.
Returns the `TyCtxt` stored in the inference context.

Type-checks a MIR statement, chiefly assignments and ascriptions, by selecting an appropriate constraint category, normalizing place/rvalue types, enforcing subtype relationships, checking user-provided type annotations, and validating statement-specific operands or trait obligations. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `normalize`, `sub_types`, `rvalue_user_ty`, `relate_type_and_user_type`, `check_rvalue`, and `check_operand`.

Type-checks MIR terminators such as switches, calls, asserts, yields, and coroutine resumes by checking operands, validating control-flow-specific type requirements, instantiating and normalizing call signatures, and enforcing argument/result compatibility. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `check_operand`, `normalize`, `check_call_dest`, `check_call_inputs`, and `sub_types`.

Validates the destination place of a call terminator by normalizing its type, choosing the right constraint category, checking that the function output type is a subtype of the destination type, and enforcing `Sized` for call destinations when unsized features are enabled. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `normalize`, `sub_types`, and `ensure_place_sized`.

Checks call-argument arity and each argument's type against the callee signature, with extra validation for certain SIMD intrinsics that require a constant argument. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `normalize`, `sub_types`, and also uses `tcx` again to query intrinsic metadata and emit diagnostics.

Verifies that cleanup-block flags are consistent with each block's terminator and all of its successors, rejecting invalid mixes such as `resume` or `terminate` on non-cleanup blocks. This method explicitly calls `assert_iscleanup` and `assert_iscleanup_unwind`.
Checks that a target basic block's `is_cleanup` flag matches the expected cleanup state and reports broken MIR if it does not.

Checks local declarations for size requirements, skipping return pointers and arguments, and enforcing `Sized` on temporaries/locals when unsized features are disabled. This method explicitly calls `unsized_feature_enabled` and `ensure_place_sized`.

Erases regions from a type, tests whether the resulting type is `Sized` in the current parameter environment, and emits the unsized-move diagnostic once per reported error site. This method explicitly calls `tcx`.

Computes the expected type of an aggregate field for ADTs, closures, coroutines, coroutine closures, or arrays, reporting out-of-range field access when needed. This method explicitly calls `tcx` and `normalize` for ADT field types.

Checks constant operands for deferred obligations, and for non-promoted inline consts proves and normalizes the instantiated predicates required by their captured environment. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `prove_closure_bounds`, and `normalize_and_prove_instantiated_predicates`.

Type-checks each MIR rvalue form by validating operands, proving well-formedness or trait obligations, checking coercions and casts, and enforcing operation-specific typing rules. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `check_operand`, `check_aggregate_rvalue`, `prove_predicate`, `prove_trait_ref`, `normalize`, and `eq_types`.
Returns the user type annotation attached to an aggregate rvalue when present, and `None` for all other rvalue kinds.

Checks aggregate construction by first proving aggregate-level predicates, then comparing each operand's normalized type against the expected field type and reporting field-count or subtype mismatches. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `prove_aggregate_predicates`, `aggregate_field_ty`, `normalize`, and `sub_types`.

Adds region constraints for reborrows by optionally exporting Polonius `loan_issued_at` facts, determining whether the borrow is for a closure upvar, and walking projections backwards to relate the new borrow region to referenced base regions. This method does not explicitly call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Builds and proves the predicates required by constructing an aggregate, using item predicates for ADTs, closure-specific propagated bounds for closures/coroutines, and no predicates for arrays/tuples. This method explicitly calls `tcx`, `prove_closure_bounds`, and `normalize_and_prove_instantiated_predicates`.

Applies propagated closure borrow-check requirements, equates closure parent arguments with the root type-checking item arguments, and returns the instantiated predicates for the closure or inline const. This method explicitly calls `eq_args` from the current checker and otherwise performs constraint conversion setup and predicate instantiation.

Drives MIR type checking for the whole body by checking every local declaration, every statement, every terminator, and each block's cleanup invariants. This method explicitly calls `check_local`, `check_stmt`, `check_terminator`, and `check_iscleanup`.
Trait hook that converts an implementing location-like value into the `Locations` form used by normalization and constraint generation.
Identity conversion from `Locations` to `Locations`.
Wraps a single `Location` as `Locations::Single`.
Performs opaque-type instantiation obligations under region-constraint scraping, stores the collected region constraints back into the error info, and returns the type-op output.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/type_check/r: Entry point for relating two MIR types under a given variance and constraint category. It constructs an `NllTypeRelating` engine with `NllTypeRelating::new`, computes diagnostics context with `UniverseInfo::relate`, and then calls `relate` to perform the actual comparison and constraint generation.

Constructs an `NllTypeRelatingDelegate` by storing the provided type-checking context, locations, constraint category, and universe diagnostic info. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns the source span for the current MIR location by querying `self.locations.span(self.type_checker.body)`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns the `ParamEnv` stored in the enclosing `TypeChecker`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Creates a fresh inference universe via the inference context, records the associated `UniverseInfo` in the borrow-checker constraint store, and returns the new universe index. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Allocates and returns a fresh existential NLL region variable, tagging its origin as existential and preserving whether it came from a `forall`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Obtains or creates the region corresponding to a placeholder binder, derives a diagnostic name for debug tracking, and in debug builds records the placeholder origin for the region variable. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Creates a fresh existential region variable in the specified universe and, in debug builds, records its origin metadata for diagnostics. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Converts the related super- and sub-regions into region variable IDs and pushes a corresponding `OutlivesConstraint` with the current locations, span, category, and variance info into the borrow-checker constraints. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
No-op delegate hook for const equality during type relating; it does not call any other methods in the provided Methods List.
Returns the eager normalization strategy for this type-relating delegate and does not call any other methods in the provided Methods List.
Reports that inference variables are forbidden during this relation process by always returning `true`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Registers an opaque-type relation by building an obligation cause from the current parameter environment and span, invoking the inference context's opaque-type handling, and then executing the resulting instantiation operation through the type checker. It does not call other methods in the provided Methods List.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_codegen_cranelift/src/uns: Computes the metadata value needed for an unsizing coercion after aligning source and target tail types. It returns a slice length for array-to-slice coercions, reuses or adjusts an existing vtable pointer for dyn trait upcasts, and otherwise builds a fresh trait-object vtable; for dyn upcasting it loads the new vtable slot from the old vtable, and for concrete-to-dyn it calls `crate::vtable::get_vtable`.

Transforms a pointer-like value into a fat-pointer pair `(data, metadata)` for an unsizing coercion. It calls `unsized_info` for reference/raw-pointer unsizing and Box unsizing, and for structurally compatible ADTs it recursively calls `unsize_ptr` on the single unsized tail field while preserving the original base pointer.

Emits the actual unsizing coercion from a source `CValue` into a destination `CPlace`. For pointer/reference cases it calls `unsize_ptr` and writes the resulting scalar pair, while for ADTs with an unsized tail field it recursively calls `coerce_unsized_into` on that field and directly copies the sized fields unchanged.
